reviewMethod: State-specific server-side evidence review against the Wave 4 remediation requirements: current tax, housing, labor, hazard/resilience and transportation sources; stronger metro/place comparison; dated review metadata; canonical/schema integrity; and sitemap qualification

reviewed.reason: Alabama now has current state income-tax evidence, current Census housing benchmarks, July 2026 official labor-market evidence, state hazard-mitigation authority and ALDOT transit evidence plus distinct Huntsville, Birmingham, Mobile and Montgomery comparison guidance.

Nevada now has official no-state-income-tax evidence, current Nevada Housing Division market resources, July 2026 workforce evidence, the state hazard-mitigation plan and NDOT transit evidence plus distinct Las Vegas, Reno-Sparks, Carson City and rural-market comparison guidance.
